No other in-flight card in this lane.

## Clause-② determination

`dispatch-gates --tier` on this surface returns **"no path-derived mandate"**. ⛔ That line is a **floor, never a clearance** — it says so itself. Judged from card **content**, this is `yes` on three independent grounds, any one of which would suffice:

1. It **removes** an elevation path (first-registrant ⇒ `platform_admin`) under walled postures — a change to runtime accept/reject on a declared security semantic.
2. It **adds a startup refusal** (walled posture + no declared owner email ⇒ refuse to boot), which is new reject behaviour.
3. It **introduces a new public `OS_*` knob**, widening the operator-facing surface.

Consequence, and this seat holds to it: the PR stays **draft**, `needs:contract-review` is on this card from claim time (⛔ not deferred to PR-open — a gate label that is missing reads as clearance, and "stripped" is indistinguishable from "never applied"), and **this seat cannot clear it** — it runs at `claude-opus-5`, below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. ⛔ No self-clear, no ready-flip, no auto-merge. Next owner after ACCEPT is a contract-review seat at tier.

⚠️ Note that dispatching the dev at `fable` does **not** retire the review: a `mode:subagent` dev cannot self-evidence its served tier (`get_session` inside a subagent measures the *dispatching* session), so the Clause-② review chain is preserved regardless.

## Premise check — done at claim time, on `origin/main`

Card filed 01:26Z, ~45 min old, so the action face is fresh; checked anyway:
- Elevation site **located and confirmed present**: `plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` (299 lines) — `:285` `[security] first user promoted to platform admin`, `:264` the "no human users yet" precondition, `:287` the seeded-record ownership handoff via `claimSeedOwnership`.
- Default-Org auto-join is a **separate plugin** by that file's own docblock (`:16–18`), which names `ensureDefaultOrganization` — so the ruling's clause 1 and clause 2 land in **two different packages**. That split is the load-bearing part of the map and is why this is graded **L**, not M.
- `plugin-auth` has taken 12 commits recently (top: `26dea14956`, `bbe643c087`, `03bdd148ee`); no landing removes or relocates the elevation path. Premise holds.

## The ruling, clause by clause — verified against the tree

**Clause 1 (walled elevates only the declared owner) — ✅ landed and pinned in both directions.** `promotes the declared owner even when a self-registrant arrived FIRST` is the positive; `owner not registered yet: refuses with the exact reason and writes NO grant` and `the group posture is walled too — a first registrant that isn't the owner never elevates` are the negatives. Case-insensitive matching pinned separately.

**Clause 3 (single posture unchanged) — ✅ landed, with the over-denial guard I required.** Two pins, and the second is the one that matters: `promotes the first human user with no owner email declared (the pre-#11184 shape)` **and** `never consults the owner-email variable: a declared owner does NOT redirect the single-org promotion`. ⭐ That second case is what stops this fix from quietly annexing the single-org path — a denial-only suite would have passed while single-org silently changed behaviour.

**Clause 4 (fail-closed boot) — ✅ landed.** `AuthPlugin.init()` throws when `postureEnforcesWall(requestedPosture) && !resolvePlatformOwnerEmail()`, and the message names `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, states why, and gives both exits (set the variable, or `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=single`). Pinned for `isolated`, `group`, the legacy `OS_MULTI_ORG_ENABLED=true` spelling, and **blank/whitespace values** — that last one is the spelling a fail-closed clause usually leaks through. Defence in depth at the elevation site itself (`reason: 'walled_owner_email_undeclared'`) covers compositions that reach the bootstrap without plugin-auth.

## ⚠️ Clause 2 is NOT implemented by this PR, and the report's "all four clauses landed" overstates it

Checked directly: `auth-plugin.ts`'s only diff is the clause-4 throw. The Default-Organization bootstrap is gated by `this.options.autoDefaultOrganization !== false && !postureEnforcesWall(resolveTenancyPosture())` — and **that gate is pre-existing, not added here**. Its own comment says walled postures are served by the enterprise organizations package instead.

So clause 2 splits, and only one half is in this repo:

- **Open-package half — already true and pinned.** `auth-plugin.test.ts` asserts `sys_organization` and `sys_member` are both length 0 under a walled posture. plugin-auth creates no org and no membership there, before or after this PR.
- **Enterprise half — ⛔ unverifiable from here.** The walled-posture Default-Org path lives in the enterprise organizations package in `objectstack-ai/cloud`. The dev flagged that it could not read that repo; **I attempted `add_repo` myself and was denied the same way**, so neither of us has read it. What this PR establishes is that a walled self-registrant no longer receives the `admin_full_access` grant — and since the open package re-runs its ensure "after every admin grant", removing the grant plausibly removes the trigger. **Plausibly is not measured.** Filed as a seam card so it is checked before cloud#1509 closes, rather than left in prose.

This is a scope boundary the card itself anticipated ("cloud#1509 is the acceptance leg"), not a defect in the PR. But it is not "landed" here and must not be recorded as such.

## Two wording corrections — neither is a defect, both matter because a review that repeats the report is not a review

1. **"The `single` promotion path is byte-identical" is falsified by the diff.** The `logger.info` call became an arm of a ternary. The emitted *text* is preserved and the behaviour is preserved — but the code is not byte-identical, and the claim invited me to skip the check that shows the behaviour survived.
2. **"All four clauses landed"** — see clause 2 above.

## File-surface breach — declared, explained, and each explanation checks out

The claim declared a narrower surface; the dev named every overrun with a reason, which is what the dispatch required. Assessed individually rather than as a block:

| Path | Reason | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` | the chokepoint every walled dogfood fixture boots through; without it clause 4 kills every walled dogfood boot, and the Dogfood Regression Gate is required | ✅ forced by clause 4 itself |
| plugin-security `tsconfig.json` + `vitest.config.ts` | the shrink-only registries of `check:type-source-resolution` / `check:test-source-alias` red the moment plugin-security value-imports `@objectstack/types`; both refuse registry-widening as the fix | ✅ forced, `packages/rest` #9960 precedent, both gates green |
| `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` | the gate's own prescribed `--write` for newly pinned coverage | ✅ forced |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | mechanical consequence of the workspace dep | ✅ |
| `@objectstack/types` dependency | **internal workspace package**, not third-party — ⛔ no maintainer floor triggered | ✅ verified by me before review |

⭐ **The pre-existing test edits are the highest-risk part of this diff and they are clean.** I checked rather than took the word: in `auth-plugin.test.ts` both assertions (`sys_organization` → 0, `sys_member` → 0) are **byte-identical**; the only change wraps them in a `try/finally` that sets and restores `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`. No assertion weakened, subject untouched. Editing existing fixtures to accommodate a new contract is exactly where a fix hides a regression, and this one does not.

## Posture

Draft held, `needs:contract-review` held, no auto-merge. Next owner is a contract-review seat at tier. ⚠️ Reviewer note: this is `priority:p0` + `security`, and objectstack-ai/cloud#1509 is blocked on it.

## ⚠️ 未裁定观察,交给档位内复审者 —— 一条可能的残留提权路径

⛔ **这不是裁决,不得当作裁决读。** 产出它的 agent 是 `mode:subagent`,**无法自证服役档位**(见下),因此按 `SKILL.md` 的降档保险丝整轮跳过、未渲染裁决、未动任何标签。`needs:contract-review` 原样留置,PR 保持 draft。这里只登记**事实观察**,判断权属于档位内复审者。

本席(`domain:services`,session `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4`)实测档位 `claude-opus-5`,低于 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`,**同样无权裁定**。登记而不裁定,是因为这条观察若成立,涉及本卡 p0 的核心目标。

### 观察内容(head `076bf67589`)

围墙姿态下的提权**只按邮箱匹配**:`bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` 的提权块筛选 `isHumanUser(u) && email.toLowerCase() === wanted`,**没有 `email_verified` 检查**;而 `requireEmailVerification` 默认为 **`false`**(`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:4190`)。

在**真正的 owner 尚未注册的窗口内**,注册路径在 walled + invite-only 部署上仍可达(这正是被实测缺陷自身的前提):一个自助注册者若**用声明的 owner 邮箱**注册,会被 `sys_user` 插入触发的重跑(`security-plugin.ts:3231-3241`)提升为平台管理员;因邮箱验证默认关闭,它可以直接登录;`claimSeedOwnership` 随后把种子记录交给它。

⇒ 这比原始漏洞窄得多(原本是「第一个注册的人」,现在是「知道 owner 邮箱的人」),但**攻击形状相同**(先 curl 注册),门槛只剩「猜到一个邮箱字符串」——而运维邮箱通常可猜。

这条残留是否可接受、是否需要加 `email_verified` 闸(那还需把重跑接到 `sys_user` **update** 而不只是 insert)、还是 owner 账号本就不该由自助注册产生——**正是契约级判断,属于档位内复审者。**

### 另外两条较轻的观察

- **大小写不敏感是单向的**:围墙查找只查声明值的小写与原样两种拼法。一条以第三种大小写存储的历史 `sys_user` 行两个查询都不匹配,后置过滤也看不到它,owner 会永久停在 `walled_owner_not_registered`,除非运维按存储拼法重新声明变量。**失败方向是 fail-closed(拒绝,不是误提权)**,但 PR 正文的「case-insensitive」说法**说过头了**。
- **`single` 姿态「byte-for-byte 不变」按字面不成立,按行为成立**:该分支被重构过(内联 filter/sort → `isHumanUser`/`oldestOf` 助手,提权日志改为三元)。查询、过滤、排序、插入、日志文本均一致 —— 行为保住了,**措辞没有**。

### 已核对无异议的部分(同样未裁定)

启动拒绝位于 `init()` 内、在 tenancy 服务注册之前(`auth-plugin.ts:496-518`),与 ADR-0093 D5 方向及 `resolveTenancyPosture()` 自身的 throw 一致;`postureEnforcesWall` 即 `posture !== 'single'`(`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts:53`,只读,PR 未触碰 `packages/spec`);`auth-plugin.ts:935` 的 `ensureDefaultOrganization` 闸是既有的;walled 拒绝时 `bootstrapRanOnce` 仍置位,所以按插入重跑保持武装;resync 路径(`cli/src/commands/meta/resync.ts:191`)命中 bootstrap 级拒绝而非启动 throw,符合设计。

### 本仓无法验证(留档)

企业版 `@objectstack/organizations` 的围墙 Default-Org 绑定(cloud 仓,条款 2 的另一半),以及已被攻陷部署的补救(cloud#1509)。

## ⚠️ 这张卡关闭 ≠ 那条提权路径已完全关闭

`Fixes #11184` 会在合入时关闭本卡。为免 cloud#1509 的验收腿把它读成「框架侧已彻底解决」,**已在入队之前立卡 #11343**,并在此明确记录:

复审裁决第 (1) 条写的是「walled elevation is keyed solely to the env-declared owner」。**该句为真的前提,是「the env-declared owner」可被可靠识别——而它是用一个未验证的邮箱字符串识别的**:提权处没有 `email_verified` 条件,而 `requireEmailVerification` 默认 `false`(`auth-manager.ts:4190`)。裁决处理了大小写变体那条观察(`5385933243` 的第 2 点),**未处理这一条**(第 1 点)。

| | 修复前 | 本 PR 落地后 |
|---|---|---|
| 谁被提权 | **第一个注册的人** | 用 owner 邮箱抢先注册的人 |
| 前提 | 抢在任何人之前注册 | **知道 owner 邮箱** + 抢在 owner 之前 |
| 手法 | curl 注册 | curl 注册 |

⇒ **这是真实且大幅的收窄,不是虚假修复**——洞从「敞开」缩到「需要一个可猜的字符串」。所以我落地它:阻拦反而让更宽的洞多敞开一段时间。但**形状未变**,后续在 #11343 追。

⚠️ #11343 里记了一个陷阱,给将来实施的人:最直接的方向(提权时要求 `email_verified`)**必须同时把 bootstrap 重跑接到 `sys_user` update**,因为邮箱验证发生在注册之后、是一次 update——只加条件不接 update,会把缺陷从「误提权」换成「owner 永不被提权」。
